bullets.text: In Uthukottai, heavy rain submerged 400 acres of paddy crops, and the office should monitor relief operations for farmers.
Near Sholavaram, police detained two lorry drivers for murdering a colleague, and the office must watch the legal proceedings.
Water-filled potholes on Velachery Main Road threaten motorists, and the department must ensure immediate road repairs.
In the Pallikaranai marshland, a buffalo died after getting stuck in mud, and corporation officials are working on rescue efforts.
The Church of South India organized an anti-drug run in Besant Nagar, highlighting substance abuse prevention.
In Poonamallee, passengers protested after waiting two hours for a government bus, requiring transport monitoring.
Agricultural officers inspected rain-damaged paddy fields in Ponneri and Minjur, advising farmers to use farm ponds.
Karukku Old Road in Ambattur faced severe waterlogging for the second consecutive year, requiring drainage checks.
Cybercrime police warned the public about online scams using AI technology to impersonate clothing brands.
Tamil Nadu designed the AI-enabled e-Sevai 2.0 platform to integrate 1,000 government services.
IT secretary Atul Anand stated that security vulnerabilities in 10 government PHP websites have been fixed.
TVK questioned former minister Sekarbabu regarding flood management at the Commissionerate office.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss urged the government to drop attempts to privatize registration and land surveying.
